verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships an official `local-ai` binary CLI. Documented subcommands include `models list`, `run` (with huggingface:// and ollama:// sources) and `local-ai chat`, an in-shell agent that reads files and runs commands behind an approval gate, plus server flags like `--external-grpc-backends` and `--preload-models`; the GitHub README corroborates the chat agent and run usage. missing for 10: a full CLI command reference in the evidence, evidence of scripting-friendly or machine-readable output modes, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond first-party sources.
